english.title: Permit use of a motor cycle with an exhaust system marked not for road use

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Road Vehicles Construction and Use Regulations 1988

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use a motor cycle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when the exhaust system fitted to the vehicle was indelibly marked with

(A)_[the words NOT FOR ROAD USE]_
(B)_[words to the effect that it was not to be used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY THE WORDS..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 57A(13) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
